verdict.rationale: Render's first-party docs say users can configure workspace webhooks that notify other systems when service events occur, such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down. These callbacks can trigger actions in third-party services or the user's own apps, which is registrable outbound event delivery a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: full event-type catalog, payload/signature verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can configure *webhooks* for your Render workspace to notify other systems when specific service events occur (such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down)
Use webhooks to trigger custom actions in third-party services (chat platforms, CI/CD, etc.) or in your own Render apps.
